raw_response:
I farm only 7 mu, and some people in my household work off-farm, so I will keep the plan simple, steady, and labor-saving. My main system is still wheat-maize, because that fits my land, water access, and my years of habit. I will put most of the land into winter wheat followed by summer maize, because that gives me the most reliable use of the year and makes full use of well irrigation. I will keep a smaller piece in cotton, because cotton is familiar to me and helps spread risk, but I will not expand it too much because it takes more management time. I will use better seed on all crops, put most fertilizer on wheat and maize, and irrigate according to the crop’s need and my well capacity. I will choose rotary tillage on most land because it is faster and suits my small farm. I will control pests enough to protect yield, but I will not spray more than needed. My goal is stable output, manageable labor, and lower production risk over the whole year.
